subject: Film & Cinema
title: Hollywood's Global Influence
description: A short lesson to help you apply Hollywood's Global Influence.

hook.text: Hollywood films play in every country. But that dominance also crowds out local voices.

buildup.text: American films account for over 60% of global box office in most countries.

discovery.text: Many nations use screen quotas to protect domestic cinema from Hollywood's overwhelming market share.

twist.text: Some filmmakers embrace Hollywood's influence. Others define themselves entirely against it.

climax.text: Hollywood's reach is cinema's greatest equalizer and its greatest threat to diversity.

punchline.text: One country's cinema became the world's default.

quiz.question: Why do some nations impose screen quotas?
options: To protect domestic cinema from Hollywood's dominant market share
